ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Privilege Escalation Attempt Via .Exe.Local Technique
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential privilege escalation attempt via the creation of the "*.Exe.Local" folder inside the "System32" directory in order to sideload "comctl32.dll"

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\logonUI\\\.exe\\\.local") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\werFault\\\.exe\\\.local") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\consent\\\.exe\\\.local") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\narrator\\\.exe\\\.local") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wermgr\\\.exe\\\.local")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\\comctl32\\\.dll$"))
